All five demo objects appear in basket; remain stationary until demonstrator returns to rest. Order doll, phone, watch, car, camera.
Demonstrator has returned to rest. Begin first object, doll, using left arm: lift and orient downward in elbow-up configuration; right arm stays home.
Move left gripper above doll and complete downward orientation, keeping left-side approach and clearance. Will refine alignment from wrist RGB.
Lower open left gripper over doll head/upper body, with small visual alignment correction. Keep other objects untouched.
Close on first target doll and make a small vertical test lift; verify retention visually before basket transfer.
Doll appears retained after test lift. Raise clear of basket rim and begin leftward transfer, gripper kept closed.
Doll remained on table, so stop transfer. Reopen and realign above the now upright doll for a deeper centered grasp, without touching later targets.
Lower gradually around the upright doll head, then close fully. The previous grasp failed; verify this one with a lift before moving to basket.
Keep fully closed, settle the doll grasp, then lift vertically for a clear retention check.
Doll is still on table after lift. Reopen and approach lower around torso, slightly toward the robot, for a more secure grasp.
Close around the doll torso and test retention with a short upward-left lift; keep all later targets outside basket.
Doll now moved with the gripper during test lift. Raise it above basket rim, then transfer left while maintaining fully closed command.
Doll is visibly retained. Carry it over the policy basket on the left, then begin lowering while keeping gripper closed.
Lower the first object into the near portion of policy basket and release. Verify doll is inside before proceeding to phone.
Doll is in policy basket with gripper open. Retract left safely; prepare right arm over second target phone in its own workspace.
Position right gripper above phone and complete downward orientation; left remains clear of basket and right workspace.
Align jaws across phone width and descend to grasp height, keeping phone second and other targets undisturbed.
Grasp phone across its sides at table height, then test vertical retention with gripper fully closed. Doll remains first in basket.
Phone visibly retained. Stage it near centerline for left-arm pickup instead of crossing right arm into the left basket workspace.
Release phone at center staging point and withdraw right arm to its side. Approach from left at clearance height with jaws aligned across phone.
Approach staged phone from the left; correct jaw yaw to match phone long axis while right arm withdraws within its workspace.
Fine-align left gripper with staged phone, descend to its sides and close. Right arm remains clear; next verify retention before basket transfer.
Lift phone vertically and slightly left with gripper fully closed. Check it follows before carrying to basket as second object.
Correct rejected tensor; no prior motion occurred. Carry retained phone over far half of policy basket, with right arm stationary and left gripper closed.
Lower and release phone as second object into far part of policy basket; confirm placement before approaching third target, watch.
Phone is inside basket after doll. Retract clear, then approach third target green watch with left arm, keeping right stationary.
Descend open left gripper around the green watch, correcting slightly rightward. Doll and phone remain in basket; watch is third.
Close across watch band at grasp height, settle, then lift briefly to verify retention. Watch must be placed third.
Correct rejected tensor; no previous motion occurred. Raise retained watch above rim and carry into policy basket as third object, keeping closed.
Lower and release watch into open space beside doll and phone, completing third placement before selecting red car.
Watch is in basket after doll and phone. Retract left vertically; approach fourth target red car with right arm and align jaws across its width.
Lower open right gripper across red car sides for fourth pickup. Left stays clear and all earlier objects remain in policy basket.
Close on red car sides and test vertical retention before staging it for left-arm transfer. Keep first three objects in basket.
Car visibly follows the right gripper. Move it to center staging area, still closed; position left arm safely on its own side for later pickup.
Set red car down at centerline staging point and open right gripper. Left waits clear until right has withdrawn; fourth placement is still pending.
Withdraw right arm to its own side while approaching staged car with left arm at clearance height. Keep arms separated and jaws open.
Align left gripper over staged car and descend to side-grasp height; right arm withdraws farther to maintain separation.
Close left gripper on car sides after a small centering correction, then lift to verify retention before fourth basket placement.
Car is retained in left grasp. Raise above basket rim and carry toward free near-right portion of policy basket, maintaining closed gripper.
Center car within near portion of basket, lower and release as fourth object. Leave fifth camera outside until this release is confirmed.
Car is inside basket as fourth object. Retract left vertically and approach final camera from right, orienting jaws across its shorter dimension.
Lower right gripper around final camera with jaws aligned across its narrow sides. Left remains clear and first four objects stay in basket.
Make a small camera centering correction, close fully and test upward retention. Camera is fifth; all prior targets remain in basket.
Camera follows right gripper during lift. Carry it to center staging point, fully closed, while left prepares on its own side for the final transfer.
Lower final camera onto center staging area and release right gripper. Left remains clear until right withdraws.
Withdraw right arm upward and rightward after staging camera. Approach final camera from left at clearance height with open gripper.
Align left gripper over staged camera and descend across its narrow sides; right withdraws farther to maintain arm separation.
Close left gripper across camera sides and test a short upward-left lift. Verify retention before final basket transfer.
Camera visibly retained after test lift. Raise clear of rim and carry it over far portion of policy basket for fifth placement; keep gripper fully closed.
Replan from observed pose after continuity rejection. Use smaller increments to center and lower the retained camera inside basket without extending farther.
Release camera as fifth object and retract left clear of basket. Begin gradual right-arm return toward origin, both grippers open.
All five policy objects are visible in basket. Return right arm to origin and bring left arm back above its own workspace, preserving elbow-up continuity and open grippers.
Return left arm to its origin with gradual orientation recovery; settle right at origin. Both grippers remain open and all objects stay in their baskets.
